run_name.title: Run label
run_name.description: Optional label used as the output prefix; defaults to the uploaded file name without extension.

abundance_threshold.title: Unique sequence abundance threshold
abundance_threshold.description: Minimum count for a unique sequence to be retained during AIRR formatting (format_labeling_imgt_airr.py -t).

clone_cdr3_similarity.title: Clone CDR3 similarity
clone_cdr3_similarity.description: CDR3 amino-acid similarity threshold (0–1) for GTM clone grouping (initial_clustering_f.py -s).

top_clones.title: Top clones for trees
top_clones.description: Number of the most abundant clones to align and build trees for (intraclonal_study_input_creator.py -s).

clonotypes_per_clone.title: Clonotypes per clone
clonotypes_per_clone.description: Comma/space-separated clonotype counts per clone to align (e.g. "30, 200" or "all"). Each value produces one tree per selected clone.

use_refinement.title: Run refinement step
use_refinement.description: Apply silhouette-based refinement before clonotype building (refinement.py).

tree_use_abundance.title: Weight trees by abundance
tree_use_abundance.description: Let clonalTree weight nodes by abundance (-a 0 enables abundance weighting).

tree_revision.title: Enable tree revision
tree_revision.description: Allow clonalTree to revise/optimise the MST (-r 0 enables revision).
